The synergy of this integration, combined with our expanded capacity, has elevated our market reach to over 5 million tonnes, firmly positioning Shree Digvijay Cement among the top three cement players in Gujarat. The year also saw changes in the promoter our erstwhile promoters, True North Fund VI LLP sold their shares to IRF Group.

triggers.detailsText: Operating Performance Revenue from operations stood at ₹ 3,091 crore in Q1 FY27, registering 38.1% year -on-year growth, while EBITDA stood at ₹ 749 crore reflecting year-on-year growth of 26.4%. Inpatient and outpatient volumes grew 38.8% and 26.0%, respectively, during the quarter, while occupancy improved by 290 basis points year -on-year to 65.0% as the network continued to absorb recently added capacity. ARPOB, excluding Sahyadri, stood at ₹ 77,200 per day, up 8.7% year -on-year, reflecting improved revenue intensity across the existing network.
filingKeyFacts: Operating Performance Revenue from operations stood at ₹ 3,091 crore in Q1 FY27, registering 38.1% year -on-year growth, while EBITDA stood at ₹ 749 crore reflecting year-on-year growth of 26.4%.

Inpatient and outpatient volumes grew 38.8% and 26.0%, respectively, during the quarter, while occupancy improved by 290 basis points year -on-year to 65.0% as the network continued to absorb recently added capacity.
ARPOB, excluding Sahyadri, stood at ₹ 77,200 per day, up 8.7% year -on-year, reflecting improved revenue intensity across the existing network.

triggers.detailsText: Kaksha Vipul Parekh, Chairperson of the Company welcomed the Members, Directors, Auditors, Scrutinizers and other invitees who had joined the meeting through VC. The Company Secretary announced that with the consent of the Members, the Notice along with the Financial Statements, Auditors Report and Directors Report already sent to Members be taken as read. The Company Secretary informed the members that the e -voting facility will remain open for further 30 minutes for members, who have not cast the vote, to cast their votes, post which the meeting shall stand concluded and thanked the Members to attending the AGM.
filingKeyFacts: Kaksha Vipul Parekh, Chairperson of the Company welcomed the Members, Directors, Auditors, Scrutinizers and other invitees who had joined the meeting through VC.
The Company Secretary announced that with the consent of the Members, the Notice along with the Financial Statements, Auditors Report and Directors Report already sent to Members be taken as read.

The Company Secretary informed the members that the e -voting facility will remain open for further 30 minutes for members, who have not cast the vote, to cast their votes, post which the meeting shall stand concluded and thanked the Members to attending the AGM.
